verses.text: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.

xrefs.text: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth— let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
And as He approached the descent from the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of disciples began to praise God joyfully in a loud voice for all the miracles they had seen:
Sing for joy, O Daughter of Zion; shout aloud, O Israel! Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, O Daughter of Jerusalem!
Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!

verses.text: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.

xrefs.text: Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and gladness of heart in all your abundance,
With one accord they continued to meet daily in the temple courts and to break bread from house to house, sharing their meals with gladness and sincerity of heart,

verses.text: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.

xrefs.text: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
“Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
Now this is eternal life, that they may know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.
For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance as our way of life.

verses.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.

xrefs.text: Let the word of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom, and as you sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs with gratitude in your hearts to God.
Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
Now therefore, our God, we give You thanks, and we praise Your glorious name.
Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.

verses.text: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.

xrefs.text: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
